name: Business Administration (MBA)

rules.name: MBA degree requirements

children.name: At least 70 letter-graded GSB units and 80 letter-graded units in all (no more than 10 pass/fail units)
GPA of at least 2.65 in all GSB courses
An approved Global Experience by the start of winter quarter of the second year
Engaging with Differences Requirement by the start of winter quarter of the second year
Six quarters, excluding summer, of full-tuition study at the GSB

rules.desc:
To earn an MBA, a student entering the 2025-2026 academic year must be in good academic standing and fulfill the following list of requirements:

• Successfully complete (with passing grades) 90 units of academic credit at Stanford University

• At least 70 must represent GSB units taken for a letter grade;

• At least 80 units must be completed at the GSB (no more than 10 non-GSB units); and

• At least 80 units must be completed for a letter grade (not on a Pass/Fail, +/U, or CR/NC basis; no more than 10 pass/fail units)

• Successfully complete (grade of LP or better, or +, when applicable) all Core Curriculum Requirements in the first year including:

• Four Leadership Foundations Requirements

• Five Analytic Foundations Requirements

• At least 15 units of Management Foundations Requirements with courses from a minimum of three of the five categories.

• Achieve a cumulative grade point average (GPA) for all GSB courses, not less than 2.65.

• Complete an approved Global Experience by the start of the Winter Quarter of the second year of the program.

• Complete the Engaging with Differences Requirement (EDR) by the start of the Winter Quarter of the second year of the program.

• Enroll for six quarters, excluding summer, of full-tuition study at the GSB.
Students are expected to complete these requirements according to the timeline stated above and in six consecutive quarters, excluding summer. A different timeline requires approval from the MBA Program and is unlikely to be granted except for students who have received approval for a leave of absence, childbirth accommodation, or a joint or dual degree. Students who do not meet the requirements according to the timeline stated above and do not have approval from the MBA Program for a different timeline, are disqualified and subject to immediate dismissal.

rules.name: Core Curriculum Requirements
rules.desc: All students in the MBA Program are required to take on the grading basis mandated and pass (with a grade of LP or higher, or +, when applicable) the Core Curriculum Requirements courses in the first year. For students beginning the first-year MBA curriculum at the GSB in the 2025-2026 academic year, this includes the Leadership Foundations courses, Analytic Foundations courses, and at least 15 units of Management Foundations courses with courses from a minimum of three of the five categories.

children.name: Analytic Foundations Requirements
children.desc: Note that Advanced-level Analytic Foundations may have eligibility requirements.

reviewNotes: The audit checks the 90 graduate units, at least 80 of them at the GSB, and the first-year core: the four Leadership Foundations courses, one course in each of the five Analytic Foundations areas, and at least 15 units of Management Foundations from three of the five categories. Core courses must be passed with LP or better on the grading basis the GSB sets; the audit does not read GSB grades, so check that yourself, along with the 70 letter-graded GSB units, the 80 letter-graded units (no more than 10 pass/fail), the 2.65 GSB GPA, the Global Experience and the Engaging with Differences Requirement by the start of winter quarter of the second year, and six quarters of full-tuition study at the GSB. All units must be taken at Stanford.
